chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 592 - A Mother's Warmth and a Madman's Proof
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang fights to recover in the real world under his mother's loving care. But a face from the past returns with a manic claim that threatens to shatter his fragile peace.
og_title: Chapter 592: The New Proof - Li Huowang's Reprieve is Shattered
og_description: A quiet chapter of hospital recovery is broken by a former doctor’s insane whisper: “I know it’s real!”
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 592 - Peace Before the Storm
twitter_description: Li Huowang is getting better. But when madness comes knocking, can he truly trust the peace he’s found?

lore_anchors.definition: A rare human constitution in the Dao-Twisted World that makes the possessor a living alchemical ingredient. Their ability to believe something into reality is both a power and a curse. Here, Li Huowang reflects on his other self as a separate, terrifying entity.
